_meta.what: The owner's own photos of Niagara Falls, used to model buildings and streets in the 3D city (data/building_specs.json). Re-encoded at 1600 px with no metadata.
_meta.upload_names: upload_NNN: photos sent in chat without their file names, numbered in the order they arrived on 2026-11-26
